warnings: Sentiment and composite market-score history are reconstructed and are not fully publication-time point-in-time archives.
Box eligibility is next-session-only after detected_at; breakout day is excluded.
Ablation event samples are de-clustered by at least 5 trading sessions; results are descriptive, not forecasts.

definitions.breadth_extreme_low: at least 2 of S&P 500/Nasdaq/Dow 20D up-down balance percentiles <= 20
definitions.score_recovering: Market Model V2 score D1 > 0 and D3 > 0
definitions.breadth_20d_pct: mean of the three indexes' point-in-time expanding percentiles of 20D up-down balance
